# `redundant-optional-unwrap`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports force-unwrapping an optional inside a scope where its payload is already
available as a capture.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Reusing the capture makes the established non-null invariant explicit and avoids
repeated optional access.

## When it fires

It applies when the capture corresponds to the same optional binding.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn use(maybe: ?u32) u32 {
    if (maybe) |value| {
        return value + maybe.?;
    }
    return 0;
}
```
